tonight.headline: Lamb and Pierce need 20.75 to beat you
body: Bad news first: nothing moved since the morning. You lead JuiceJam 89.76 to 69.02 with every AVIATO player final, and ESPN still gives them 65% because CeeDee Lamb (projected 18.6) and Dameon Pierce (6.9) play Dallas–Philadelphia at 18:15 CDMX tonight.
They need 20.75 between them. Barkley is 'trending toward playing' (Garafolo, 26 Oct), which keeps Pierce a backup. You can do nothing about it.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Their projections alone get there: Lamb 18.6 plus Pierce 6.9 is 25.5 against the 20.75 they need. Lamb is not on Dallas's final report (SportsBettingDime MNF report).

case.label: The script that saves it
case.body: Barkley plays a full load — he practised fully and is questionable only on the label (Eagles report; Garafolo 12:57Z) — so Pierce stays a few-touch backup, while Lamb lands under his projection against a Philadelphia defence without corner Michael Carter II.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley inactive at 16:45 CDMX — then Pierce is Philadelphia's lead back and the 35% is generous. Inactives were not out when this snapshot was taken.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: WHEN THE WEEK ROLLS — Tue, once Week 8 unlocks
doFirst.title: Allen back in at quarterback over Love
doFirst.subtitle: Love started only for Buffalo's Week 7 bye. Make the swap before Green Bay kick off on Thursday — once Love's game starts he is locked in the QB slot.

case.label: The move
case.body: Josh Allen returns from the bye and Buffalo host Baltimore in Week 8 (SI Bills, 26 Oct); Jordan Love was added on 15 Oct for this one week. One quarterback starts in Chem.

case.label: The clock — new this afternoon
case.body: Green Bay play Carolina on Thursday night: the Packers filed an estimated Monday report for a short week (Packers.com, 26 Oct, 16:41). If Love is still in the QB slot when that game kicks off, he locks there for Week 8 and Allen cannot come in. The Week 8 kickoff time is not in this snapshot, so the card says 'when the week rolls' — in practice that means Tuesday or Wednesday.

case.label: The rest of Week 8
case.body: Likely (Giants), Fairbairn (Texans) and Kamara (Saints) are on bye; Tuten and Diggs return. Coker plays Thursday too, listed limited Monday with a shoulder (Packers.com estimated report). Tuesday's run sets the RB/WR slots and the tight-end and kicker covers on Week 8 projections.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love outscores Allen in Week 8 (archive) — graded on the outcome. Allen injured before Week 8 voids it.

whatWentWrong.title: The bye lineup carries into Week 8 — and Love locks on Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: Love is in the QB slot and Allen on the bench; Green Bay play Thursday night, so the swap has a real cut-off.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Love scored 17.0 covering Buffalo's bye, as planned. The thing that made the QB slot right this week makes it wrong next week — and the Packers' Thursday game (Packers.com estimated report, 26 Oct) means the window closes at that kickoff, not Sunday.

case.label: What it changes

whatWentWrong.title: 5.6 points sat on the bench — and the projection was still right
whatWentWrong.lead: Kamara 13.2 on the bench, Metcalf 7.6 in the flex; Chem's flex takes either.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Metcalf projected 14.9 against Kamara's 8.2 (league file) — a 6.7-point gap, not a coin flip. Kamara caught seven of seven; Metcalf two of six (archive).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the method: STRATEGY §1 sets the lineup by projection and a projection-backed call that loses is variance. It does add up to the review question: 5.6 bench points this week, none from an override.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A pattern of the passing-back role outscoring Metcalf over Weeks 8-9 that ESPN keeps failing to price — two weeks would make it a question, not one.

whatWentWrong.lead: Likely, Fairbairn and Kamara are off; Chem carries no second tight end and one kicker.

case.body: Tuesday's run picks a tight end and a kicker on Week 8 projections; claims clear Wed 28 Oct 01:00 CDMX and Chem's priority resets weekly. Love is the natural drop once Allen is back.
